bb4f4fc8f71b5f405f9df4e7762bf8dc706fbfd4.summary: Malwarebytes' Threat Intelligence Team reports on the Silent Librarian APT (also tracked as TA407 and COBALT DICKENS), which runs spear phishing campaigns against universities. The report says the group has targeted universities around each new academic year since 2018, using phishing sites that imitate university login and library pages. Some hosting was found in Iran, and Cloudflare is used to hide the real hosting origin. bb1b36eee7a0cd45544a9757afd6de35d71e5a0d.summary: A Snort rule documentation page for alert 1:34217, a MALWARE-CNC rule for a Win.Trojan.Aytoke variant outbound connection. The rule flags a possible host infection in which the host calls out to a control server for files or other stages, or relays traffic to bot owners. The page gives no actor, sector, country, CVE or figure. Cisco Talos is listed as a contributor. The page states that there is no public information on known usage and no known false positives.
